observations: Photos show a used automatic gearbox/transmission assembly on a workshop floor/engine bay setting.
No clear Ford Fusion branding/label, no visible VIN/part number, and no readable model/gearbox code in the photos.
The transmission case has a circular bellhousing area and multiple ports; there is visible grime/wear consistent with used parts.
Seller text claims “American Drive Gearbox Ford Fusion” and “Available 4 cylinder”, but the photos do not show the vehicle/engine capacity details.

claims.evidence: Photos show a gearbox but no readable Ford Fusion identification/part label.
No readable engine capacity/cylinder info or matching label visible on the gearbox photos.
No paperwork, shipping marks, or readable tags in the photos to confirm origin.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: Photos only show the gearbox externally; no test video, no mileage proof, and no seal/inspection evidence.

risks.risk: Wrong fitment (gearbox may not match Ford Fusion 4-cylinder variant: different bellhousing/gear ratios/connector pinouts).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the gearbox identification tag/part number (sticker/metal stamping) and the transmission code, plus the exact Ford Fusion year/engine (e.g., 1.5/2.0) it came from.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: not guaranteed to fit/unknown compatibility.

risks.risk: Condition uncertainty (seller says tested/working/no knock, but no proof; could have internal wear or noise under load).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of the gearbox being run/engaged (reverse/drive) with sound, or a mechanic’s test sheet/receipt.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: not proven working.

risks.risk: Unknown mileage and whether it was opened/overhauled (seller claims never opened/low mileage).
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of case bolts/seams and any factory seals/paint marks, and whether there are signs of resealing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: mileage/overhaul status unknown.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts (some transmissions require specific sensors, solenoids, torque converter, wiring harness connectors). Photos don’t confirm completeness.
risks.proof: Ask for a checklist photo of included items (torque converter, starter ring, sensors/solenoids, shifter/selector parts if applicable) laid out.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: may be incomplete and may require extra parts.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the gearbox identification tag/part number/transmission code (the stamping/sticker on the case).
State the exact Ford Fusion year and engine size it came from (and share a photo of the donor vehicle/engine bay label if possible).
Provide a short video showing the gearbox engaged (Drive/Reverse) with sound, or a test receipt.
Show close-ups of seals/case seams/bolt heads to support “never opened”.
Confirm what is included (torque converter, sensors/solenoids, any harness/connector parts) with a laid-out photo.
response.reason: The photos confirm a used gearbox, but the key details needed to price confidently (exact model/fitment code, proven working status, completeness) are not readable or proven in the images.
